content: No published average; measured 3 real w342 posters: 63KB, 77KB, 91KB (~75KB avg). Estimate 400 posters ≈ 30MB; profile headshots w185 ~10-20KB × 5/movie × 400 ≈ 30MB. Local cache mode ≈ 60MB in repo — acceptable once, but every re-fetch churns history; keep opt-in and prefer poster-only caching.
